verdict.rationale: Trivy has a documented license scanner that scans container images for license files and assigns a risk classification (trivy-docs-5), which combined with Trivy's general CI exit-code gating (trivy-probe-6, trivy-probe-8) supports basic license risk enforcement. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit detail on a dedicated license-policy mechanism (e.g., custom allow/deny lists), so enforcement beyond severity-based risk flagging is not clearly demonstrated.
